t: This is Hornsey Lane, a street running between the London Boroughs of Haringey and Islington. It sits in the same part of north London as the A1, the great road that runs from the City up through Islington, Holloway and Highgate on its way to Edinburgh. Sir Cory Cory-Wright, the first Baronet, lived on this lane. He was a British businessman, born in 1838, and he died in 1909. The material I have on him is brief, so that is all I will say.
